name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair MacLeod's journey into motorsport HR was somewhat unconventional, starting with a degree in psychology and a brief stint in corporate recruitment. He quickly realized his passion lay in the high-octane world of racing, and he successfully transitioned his skills to ART Grand Prix a decade ago. Alistair is known for his ability to identify and nurture talent, creating a supportive and collaborative environment within the team.

His approach to HR is rooted in understanding the unique pressures and demands of motorsport. He focuses on building strong relationships with staff, ensuring their well-being, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Alistair is particularly adept at conflict resolution and mediation, playing a vital role in maintaining team harmony. His creative approach to problem-solving and genuine care for the team make him an invaluable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Alistair has a friendly face and a sturdy build, often seen with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always has a tin of shortbread on his desk.
Uses motorsport analogies in everyday conversations.
Keeps a meticulously organized spreadsheet of employee birthdays.
